I'm feeling a bit overwhelmed, to be honest."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I’m sorry to hear that. It sounds like a lot is going on right now. Would you like to talk about what’s been happening?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Yeah, it's just everything piling up. I recently found out that my family member’s illness is much more serious than we thought."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Oh no, Amanda. That must be incredibly difficult news to process. How are you coping with it?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"It's been really tough. My mind is constantly racing, worrying about what might happen next."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It’s completely understandable to feel that way. It seems like there are a lot of uncertainties right now. Have you been able to talk to anyone in your family about it?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Not really. Everyone's trying to stay strong, but honestly, I feel kind of alone in all this."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Feeling isolated during tough times is so challenging. Do you think talking with them could help you feel more connected?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Maybe. I just don’t want to burden them with my emotions when they’re handling their own."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I get that. But remember, sharing how you feel can also be a way to support each other. It might be comforting for them to know they’re not alone in their worries either."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Yeah, I guess you’re right. I’ll try to reach out more."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That’s a brave step, Amanda, and I’m really proud of you for considering it. How's everything else with work and personal life? Are they adding to your stress?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Work has been demanding too. I'm worried about the new promotion. It's great, but the responsibility is daunting, especially now."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Taking on more responsibility, while all of this is happening, must feel overwhelming. Have you thought about what help or changes could make it more manageable for you?"}]
